exposure: Patients who underwent postpartum scoliosis radiography
outcome: Obstetric complications (preterm births, induction of labor, and urgent/emergency caesarean section delivery)
Regional anesthetic decision making and success during delivery
cohort: Pregnant patients diagnosed with AIS at the authors' institution who delivered between January 2002 and September 2016
finding: The severity of scoliosis did not affect delivery complications or regional anesthetic decision making in pregnant patients with AIS, and scoliosis did not progress significantly during or immediately after pregnancy.
mod_finding: The severity of scoliosis in pregnant patients with AIS did not appear to affect delivery complications or the success rate of regional anesthesia.
